description: Use for scheduling, payroll calendars, travel planning or "is the office closed?": returns every public holiday for a country (e.g. LT, US, DE, JP) in a given year from Nager.Date (~100 countries). Each holiday has date, English name, local name, whether it is nationwide (global) or limited to counties/states, fixed vs movable, and types (Public, Bank, School, Optional, Authority). Public, non-personal data. Paid tool: x402 USDC on Base, $0.001 per successful call; call without payment to receive the PaymentRequired object.
